integrity: Exact rational finite tests accompany the proof. The proof covers every integer n>=1 and every q>=3, with strict negative determinants for all letter transitions. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Necessary condition and polynomial upper bound only; no sufficiency, sharpness or mixed-sign conclusion. Binary classification is prior work. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Parity-run obstruction for decreasing two-state probabilistic automata over arbitrary finite alphabets
